name: A flower garden
intro: Start the team to grow three flowers, with 8, 10 and 12 petals. A stem, two leaves and a ring of tilted petals each, drawn by a repeat inside a repeat inside a repeat: twenty segments make a petal, petals make a flower, flowers make the garden. Instant shows it at once. Click next member above Trained actions to see each of the seven robots. The pad on the table has things to try.

thing.text:
TRY

Set "flowers left" to 1 and
watch one flower closely.

Each petal is twenty turns
of 18 degrees -- a full
turn. In the letters box,
what if "move yaw" said 20?

Sweep a flower up with
Dusty: one thing -- stem,
leaves and petals (the pen
went invisible between
them).

active.name: Garden complete

team.name: Plant flower 1
team.note: Flowers left is 3: this pen. Grow a stem and two leaves, then get ready for 8 petals in #ed5393.

team.name: Plant flower 2
team.note: Flowers left is 2: this pen. Grow a stem and two leaves, then get ready for 10 petals in #8f73ed.

team.name: Plant flower 3
team.note: Flowers left is 1: this pen. Grow a stem and two leaves, then get ready for 12 petals in #ffad37.

team.name: Finish flower
team.note: No petals left: back to the top of the stem, a golden centre dropped there, the pen hidden, and one flower fewer to plant.

team.name: Begin petal
team.note: Petals are left: back to the top of the stem in invisible ink, face the next spoke, tilt up 55 degrees, and the petal colour. Twenty segments to draw.

team.name: Next petal
team.note: Twenty segments have closed the petal: one petal fewer, and the heading turns on by the petal turn.

team.name: Draw petal segment
team.note: The innermost repeat: forward a little, turn 18 degrees, one segment fewer. Twenty of these make a petal, 8, 10 or 12 petals a flower, three flowers a garden.

active.note: No flowers are left to plant: puts the work box away. The three flowers stay.
